limitations_and_boundaries: The study primarily uses in vitro and in vivo models; clinical relevance in human metastasis requires further validation.
The biophysical model proposed is based on observed correlations and requires direct mechanical measurements for confirmation.
The role of other repair pathways or compensatory mechanisms was not exhaustively explored.
The selected source chunks do not report a rescue, reconstitution, reversal, or epistasis experiment; that rung of the causal evidence chain remains untested within this extraction scope.
